title: The Gravity of New Lagos
author: L. M. Amberdale
blurb: Petra Thackeray, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
